hypothesis: Fifteen-minute directional context may explain part of the after-cost difference among side-aligned-book candidates withheld only by the completed 5-minute BREAKOUT requirement, but it must remain a prospective outcome stratifier until repeatable deployable evidence exists in both directions.
decision: Keep the authorized v14 runtime, exact 5-minute breakout requirement, sizing, exits, and execution scope unchanged. Add report-only 15-minute context stratification beside the existing 5-minute entry-context summary and expose it in the TUI research inspector. The second post-cutoff HYPE attempt is deployable but pending with 15-minute opposition; its fixed 60-minute result is a predeclared direct falsifier. The second SOL attempt is also pending and 15-minute aligned but remains non-deployable because the real SOL position occupies that symbol. Do not filter, rank, size, route, close, or promote from these sparse same-run observations.
falsifier: The directional-context hypothesis is weakened if the pending 15-minute-opposed deployable HYPE path resolves positive after full costs, if future neutral or opposed deployable paths match or outperform aligned paths, or if aligned results lose profitability after costs. It gains support only if multiple independent deployable observations include both long and short sides, aligned paths remain positive after costs without one-path concentration, and neutral or opposed paths are consistently worse. Any use as an execution gate before that evidence would invalidate this revision's contract.
limitations: The same-run detailed prefixes were inspected after their outcomes and are hypothesis-formation evidence, not prospective validation.
The detailed full-prefix non-overlap schedule differs from the post-cutoff schedule, so their paths cannot be pooled as one portfolio result.
Only one prospective outcome per symbol has resolved and both are shorts; no repeatability or bidirectional edge is established.
The HYPE prospective sample is one neutral-context loss; the second opposed-context HYPE path remains pending and must not be scored early.
Both SOL attempts conflict with an occupied live SOL position and therefore remain mechanism-only rather than deployable portfolio evidence.
Recorded BBO, top-level capacity, taker fees, and official funding still estimate rather than prove private IOC execution and latency.
Fifteen-minute context is descriptive telemetry only and cannot gate, veto, rank, size, route, close, or promote a trade.
The fixed 60-minute challenger tests entry selection rather than the deployed 8-to-24-hour exit controller.
One evidence file cited by historical revision 1 remains reported as changed; revision 10 does not conceal that prior integrity drift.
No live strategy, position, order, stop, target, sizing policy, backend process, or portfolio configuration changed as a result of this revision.
